entries.title: I Corinthians 12:1
segments: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brothers, I would not have you ignorant.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:2
segments: You know that being led away, you nations were led to dumb idols.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:3
segments: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by [the] Spirit of God says Jesus [is] a curse, and [that] no one can say that Jesus [is] Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:4
segments: But there are differences of gifts, but the same Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:5
segments: And there are differences of ministries, but the same Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:6
segments: And there are differences of workings, but it is the same God working all things in all.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:7
segments: But to each one is given the showing forth of the Spirit to [our] profit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:8
segments: For through the Spirit is given to one a word of wisdom; and to another a word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:9
segments: and to another faith by the same Spirit; and to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:10
segments: and to another workings of powers, to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; and to another kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:11
segments: But the one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing separately to each one as He desires.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:12
segments: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, [are] one body; so also [is] Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:13
segments: For also by one Spirit we are all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free, even all were made to drink into one Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:14
segments: For the body is not one member, but many.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:15
segments: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:16
segments: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:17
segments: If all the body [were] an eye, where [would be] the hearing? If all hearing, where [would be] the smelling?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:18
segments: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body as it has pleased Him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:19
segments: And if they were all one member, where [would be] the body?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:20
segments: But now indeed many [are] the members, yet only one body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:21
segments: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of you; nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:22
segments: But much rather the members of the body seeming to be weaker are necessary.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:23
segments: And those [members] of the body which we think to be less honorable, on these we put more abundant honor around [them]. And our unpresentable [members] have more abundant propriety.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:24
segments: For our presentable [members] have no need, but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to the [member] having need;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:25
segments: that there not be division in the body, but [that] the members should have the same care for one another.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:26
segments: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer with [it]; if one member is glorified, all the members rejoice with [it].

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:27
segments: And you are the body of Christ, and members in part.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:28
segments: And God set some in the church, firstly, apostles; secondly, prophets; thirdly, teachers, then works of power, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, kinds of languages.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:29
segments: [Are] all apostles? [Are] all prophets? [Are] all teachers? [Are] all workers of power?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:30
segments: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak languages? Do all interpret?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:31
segments: But zealously strive after the better gifts. And yet I show to you a more excellent way.
